annotations.title: How to connect Ortexo and sign in

description: How to connect Ortexo to an AI assistant and how to sign back in, step by step for Claude, Claude Code, ChatGPT and other assistants: the server address, the page where each one is connected and the exact commands. Needs no sign-in, reads no data and costs nothing. The server address is https://mcp.ortexo.com/mcp. Claude connects it at https://claude.ai/customize/connectors. Claude Code adds it with: claude mcp add --transport http --scope user ortexo https://mcp.ortexo.com/mcp, and the person signs in with /mcp (Authenticate) or claude mcp login ortexo. Other assistants: https://ortexo.com/mcp.
